title: Tom and the Dog
text:
Tom has a small dog. The dog is brown and very happy. Every morning, Tom and the dog go to the park.

In the park, the dog runs fast after a red ball. Tom laughs and throws the ball again. They walk home at noon.

questions.text: What does the dog run after in the park?
How does Tom probably feel in the park?
Why do Tom and the dog go to the park every morning?

vocabulary.definition: makes sounds with the voice to show something is funny or happy
sends something through the air with the hand
twelve o'clock in the middle of the day

paragraph_translations: Tom ma małego psa. Pies jest brązowy i bardzo szczęśliwy. Każdego ranka Tom i pies idą do parku.
W parku pies szybko biegnie za czerwoną piłką. Tom się śmieje i znowu rzuca piłkę. Wracają do domu w południe.
